description: This file defines the class SugarCronRemoteJobs, a specialized cron job handler that manages remote job submission via HTTP REST calls. It extends the base SugarCronJobs class and adds functionality for interacting with a remote job server, including executing jobs and handling responses.

classes.name: SugarCronRemoteJobs
classes.description: A class that manages remote execution of scheduled jobs via HTTP API, inheriting core cron functionalities from SugarCronJobs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class, sets the job server URL from global configuration if available, and initializes the HTTP client.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Sets the HTTP client used for communication with the remote job server.

methods.name: getMyId
methods.description: Generates and returns a unique identifier for this client instance based on configuration.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Sends a job execution request to the remote server and handles response, marking the job failed if the server rejects it or communication fails.
